prompts.note: card's own showcase prompt, replayed on purpose

prompts.text: Create a wizard's tower that is also a giant teapot, with a spout balcony and a tiny round door.
Create a pirate ship made entirely of stacked pancakes, with a syrup-barrel cannon and a waffle sail.
Create a cheerful toaster knight with a bread-slice shield and a butter-knife sword.
Create a snail-shaped mobile bakery with a chimney on its shell and a serving window.
Create a rubber duck submarine with a periscope and a small propeller.
Create a haunted vending machine with glowing eyes behind the glass and a tentacle coming out of the coin slot.
Create a cactus wearing a sombrero and sunglasses, holding a tiny cup of tea.
Create a robot grandmother knitting an endless scarf that coils around her armchair.
Create a floating island shaped like a sleeping whale, with a tiny village on its back.
Create a dragon made of traffic cones and road signs, wearing a hard hat.
Create a windmill whose blades are giant spatulas, with the blades turning.
prompts.note: the only prompt that asks for animation
